descriptions.text: Tome of Legionnaires of the Damned. Type: Summoning Spell. Cost: 25 mana Duration: (spell level*2 + intelligence level) seconds. Cooldown: One minute. May only have one active instance of this spell at a time. Target: May only be cast on recently-unequipped armor or weapons. Total targets allowed varies based on multiple factors. Effect: There are a lot of angry souls out there. Like, a lot. It's said if one has the ability to actually see all the wailing souls that filter through the edges of our world, one would go quite insane. …

recap.text: Donut's De-Sleeving box holds 100,000 gold and a chained tome that bounces, smokes purple, and wriggles like a puppy in Carl's hands. Its spell fills armour with undead spirits, and Mordecai sees that Laundry Day at level fifteen lets Donut strip mobs and turn their gear on them. She applies it, and the tome screams a little and vanishes in purple smoke. She blasts Bomo's armour off him like a grenade, and ghosts pour screaming into the pieces.

beats.headline: Chained shut, and quivering
beats.text: Donut's De-Sleeving box holds 100,000 gold and a kind of spellbook Carl has never seen: thick as a dictionary, with a bumpy leather cover, chained shut with a lock, bouncing about on its own and giving off purple smoke. It reminds him of the spellbook in the Evil Dead movies, and Mordecai gasps. When Donut gives it an uncertain slap with her paw and asks why it is quivering, Mordecai says that happens sometimes with the more powerful tomes, especially summoning ones. In Carl's hands it is squishy and warm, and it wriggles like a puppy.
beats.gist: Donut's chained tome quivers and wriggles like a puppy, and Mordecai says summoning tomes do that.

beats.headline: A little scream
beats.text: The spell reanimates weapons and armour with undead spirits plucked from the river of falling souls, and most of the gear disintegrates when it ends. Mordecai sees the combination at once: with Laundry Day at level fifteen, Donut can strip a group of mobs of their armour and turn it on them, full of wailing spirits. Carl slides the tome back to her. She glows as she applies it, and it lets out a little scream as it disappears in a puff of purple smoke.
beats.gist: Donut applies the summoning tome, and it screams and vanishes in purple smoke.

beats.headline: The Phantasm move
beats.text: Donut casts Laundry Day on Bomo, and the armour Carl made for him at his armourer's table, dozens of metal pieces and trash-tier daggers sewn one by one onto a fabric undershirt, explodes off him like a fragmenting grenade. Then she casts part two, her new spell. A purple rent opens above the temple, dozens of wispy white ghosts pour down screaming into the scattered armour on the floor, and every piece starts to shake. It is working.
beats.gist: Donut casts Laundry Day on Bomo, his armour explodes off, and her new spell sends ghosts into it.
